character.name: Kaal Bhairav Nazar Battu
character.description: A traditional Kaal Bhairav (Bhairava) face mask: a fierce decorative wall-hanging plaque used as a nazar battu (evil-eye protection charm) in Indian homes. A wrathful bearded face with bulging round eyes, a third eye on the forehead, prominent fangs, a serpent or crown adorning the head, ornate carved brass/terracotta texture with intricate detailing, a small loop at the top for hanging near an entrance.

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
